name: reachability
author: f6f61ae0
description: Checks whether any path exists from source to target using breadth-first search. Use for questions such as whether one airport can reach another. Supports directed and undirected, weighted and unweighted graphs; follows outgoing edges and ignores weights. Returns source and target node references and a reachable boolean; a node reaches itself.

graph_id.description: ID of the graph to analyse.

source.description: Starting node ID; resolve names with lookup_node.

target.description: Destination node ID; resolve names with lookup_node.
